# ArkhamPad

> ArkhamPad is an AI-powered token launchpad and trading platform on Robinhood Chain and Base. Create a token by describing it in one sentence, trade with a single dollar balance (no gas token needed), and see who really holds every token through AI safety checks and a live holder map of linked wallets.

## Key pages
- [Markets](https://arkhampad.com/): live tokens on Robinhood Chain, Base and BNB, with trending, new and graduating lists
- [Create a token](https://arkhampad.com/create/): AI writes the name, ticker, story and logo from one sentence
- [Terminal](https://arkhampad.com/terminal/): fast trading view with charts, orders and live trades
- [Learn](https://arkhampad.com/learn/): guides on launching, trading and staying safe

## Facts
- Chains: Robinhood Chain (Ethereum L2 on Arbitrum, mainnet since July 1, 2026) and Base
- Balance and prices in dollars; network fees are taken from the balance
- Login: Google, email, X or a wallet
- Contact: team@arkhampad.com
